files.name: motion-prompt-125.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Pulse" (パルス), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves, part 2".
Motion Prompt #125

What it is: Its size throbs like a heartbeat
What the sample shows: A heart throbs like a heartbeat, a double beat each time, with rings spreading out.
Spec:
- A coral heart. One beat per 1.175 s (four per 4.7 s); each beat is a double "lub-dub".
- Scale = 1 + 0.26·G(0.2 s, width 0.065) + 0.15·G(0.44 s, width 0.07), where G = e^(−((t − centre) ÷ width)²): a quick swell that drops straight back.
- Two heart-shaped outlines spread from 0.16 s and 0.40 s: scale 1.2→2.4 over 0.8 s, cubic ease-out.
- As they spread, their opacity goes 0.75→0 (the second at 60%) and the line width 8.5→1.5 px.
When to use it: Use it for a like, a recording or live indicator, or a button you want pressed, to make it feel alive.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/125.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion2.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
